build_encoder_with_resnext101: build a MiDaS encoder using _make_encoder with a ResNeXt-101 WSL pretrained backbone and scratch layers
create_scratch_conv_layers: create scratch Conv2d layers from in_shape channels to a uniform out_shape using _make_scratch
build_interpolate_module: build an Interpolate nn.Module that upscales a tensor by a given scale_factor and interpolation mode
create_residual_conv_unit: create a ResidualConvUnit with two 3x3 conv layers and ReLU that adds input as a residual
build_feature_fusion_block: build a FeatureFusionBlock that fuses two feature tensors via residual conv units and upsamples by 2x
